title.rendered: Order your school apparel / spirit wear

content.rendered:
This year we are excited to have the opportunity to offer online ordering for our spirit wear. Attached are two links. The first link is accessories where you can order bows, hats, and socks! The second link is for apparel where you can order long and short sleeve apparel. All items ordered will be purchased and paid for online and delivered to you before winter break.  Everything will be sent home with your child upon delivery.

 Please be aware that these websites are only up for a short time, and once they are closed you will not be able to place your order.  You have until  Friday, November 11/09/18 to place all orders then the sites will be closed.

 If you would like the order to be a surprise you will need to email Mary Timmons at: Marytimmons25@yahoo.com. We will do the best we can to work with you on making sure this stays a surprise.

 

Thank you for all your continued support of our school! #LuckyME
